PRIVACY

Your research stays attributable.

Effective 7 October 2026

RippleMap is an early-stage research product. This policy explains the data used to operate authentication, cloud synchronization, analytics, and AI-assisted analysis.

Data we process

When you sign in, we process your email address and authentication session through Supabase. Saved investigations can include your research question, selected market symbols, market snapshots, generated analysis, linked sources, and timestamps. We also record limited product events such as workspace loads, completed investigations, saves, shares, exports, and errors.

How data is used

We use this information to authenticate you, synchronize your research, operate public links you create, maintain reliability, prevent abuse, and improve the product. Research questions and market snapshots are sent to a third-party AI service to generate the requested synthesis. Live market requests are made to Bitget, and recent reporting may be discovered through news indexing services.

Sharing and visibility

Investigations are private to your account by default. Selecting “Create share link” makes that investigation available through a public read-only URL. Do not include confidential or personal information in a publicly shared investigation.

Storage and security

Authentication and cloud research records are stored with Supabase. Access controls restrict private records to their owner. No internet service is perfectly secure, so avoid submitting secrets or regulated personal data.

Your choices

You may use the local workspace without signing in, delete saved investigations in the product, sign out, or request deletion of account-associated data through the project maintainer.

Contact

Account-associated records can be deleted with the controls available in the product.
